purpose: Teach: 乗務/境遇/エキスパート/未経験/県議会/等級/書名/修得

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、乗務員の研修を充実させろ
lines.en: I want our training programs for drivers to be more robust.
lines.style: Measured, declarative. Direct eye contact. No softening. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard. Slight emphasis on 'our' — ownership, not question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の境遇に配慮します
lines.en: Understood. We'll make sure to take the circumstances of our valued clients into account.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight forward lean. Absorbing the directive without hesitation. Professional clarity — he's already mentally organizing the next steps.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、エキスパートを社外から招聘しろ
lines.en: Bring in external experts. I want that expertise in-house.
lines.style: Firm, expectant. Pause after the first phrase for weight. No negotiation in the delivery. The voice of someone who knows what works.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。未経験者向けの研修を準備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll set up training modules for people new to the role.
lines.style: Focused, affirming. Light nod implied in the voice. Taking ownership of the task. Calm efficiency — detail-oriented but not fussy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、県議会の動向を注視しろ
lines.en: Pay close attention to what's happening in the prefectural assembly. It matters to us.
lines.style: Serious, penetrating. Slower pace here — this one carries weight. Eye contact held. The implication that he's thinking several moves ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の等級分けを再検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll revisit how we categorize our products.
lines.style: Attentive, making mental notes. Brief pause before speaking — he's already thinking through the implications. Steady, capable tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新刊書名を市場調査しろ
lines.en: We need market research on new publication titles. Do it thoroughly.
lines.style: Clear, unhurried. Slight weight on 'thoroughly' without sounding harsh. The expectation of quality is built into the phrasing, not imposed after.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人が技術を修得するまで支援します
lines.en: Understood. I'll support our new staff through the learning curve until they've mastered the technical side.
lines.style: Composed, showing readiness to close out the meeting. Respectful but not deferential. The confidence of someone who knows what he's committing to.
